title: Open sensor candidate access observations
status: Research evidence; no profile rule, implementation or conformance claim is adopted

evidenceConventions.recordIds: Local to this research study. These IDs do not extend or replace the project source or requirement registries.
evidenceConventions.excerpts: Selected exact source fields or lines only. Excerpt objects are not complete response bodies; JSON Pointer keys identify locations in the original response.
evidenceConventions.observedFieldValues: For records without retained original bytes, these are prior research observations, not independently hash-verified excerpts.
evidenceConventions.hashes: SHA-256 and byteLength describe original captured response bytes checked in temporary research storage. Those complete response bodies are not archived in this repository.
evidenceConventions.timestamps: retrievedAtUTC appears only where the original research captured a retrieval time. retrievedOnUTC is used when only the date is retained. Sensor times are separate source data.
evidenceConventions.privacy: Published excerpts omit account/owner attributes, tokens, contributor personal text and exact measurement coordinates. The Safecast request URL retains its original public search-centre parameters for reproducibility.
evidenceConventions.licensing: Dataset, firmware, hardware, documentation and media rights are separate. Policy pointers support future attribution review; availability does not imply unrestricted redistribution.
evidenceConventions.access: Successful HTTP reads establish access at the recorded date/time, not continuous availability or permission to command or reconfigure a third-party device.
